body:
## Context
The dashboard currently uses a dark visual theme by default. There is no built-in light theme or user-facing theme toggle.

## Goal
Support both dark and light themes, with a simple toggle available on the dashboard.

## Suggested Scope
- Add theme tokens for dark and light modes instead of hardcoding one palette.
- Add an accessible theme toggle in the dashboard UI, likely near the top controls or sidebar.
- Default sensibly, for example respect `prefers-color-scheme` when no saved choice exists.
- Persist the user's selected theme locally, for example with `localStorage`.
- Ensure charts, tool-source colors, tables, cards, focus states, tooltips, and settings page remain readable in both themes.
- Avoid changing the dashboard's data contract or source-provenance wording.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Users can switch between light and dark mode from the dashboard.
- The selected mode persists across reloads.
- Both themes meet readable contrast for cards, tables, charts, buttons, and tooltips.
- Settings page follows the same theme behavior or has a clear plan if deferred.
- Existing unit tests pass and a visual smoke check covers both themes.
title: Add light and dark theme support with dashboard toggle
